result:
The proposed answer (32, 34) is probably wrong in its rod-group count. I checked the layer-group part by argument and the rod-group part only against my memory of the published result.

**Layer groups.** The argument that each layer group is either a wallpaper group $W$ or $W\times\mathbb{Z}_2$ is sound. The projection to the plane has kernel $1$ or $\langle\sigma_h\rangle$, and all 17 wallpaper groups occur in both cases. These 34 groups are pairwise non-isomorphic, because quotienting by the maximal finite normal subgroup recovers $W$, and wallpaper groups are pairwise non-isomorphic. So 34 layer-group classes looks right.

**Rod groups.** The solution's classification is only sketched. It never verifies that the 75 groups distribute as claimed (for example, 29 versus 46, and 13 versus 19 classes), and several of the listed isomorphism types are asserted without proof. My recollection of the published result is that the 75 rod groups form 31 isomorphism classes, not 32, so the rod count is likely off by one. I could not reproduce the exact count independently, so this rejection rests on that recollection.

VERDICT: REJECT
